task.ques: On the Apple website, look up the processor for the latest model of the Apple TV.

claude.final_answer: FINAL: The latest Apple TV is Apple TV 4K (4th generation), powered by the A19 chip. Apple labels it “New” on its Home lineup, and its technical specifications list “Processor — A19 chip” and “Apple TV 4K (4th generation)” under In the Box. Verified October 27, 2026. Sources: https://www.apple.com/home/ and https://www.apple.com/apple-tv-4k/specs/ . Evidence: final.png.
